checks.name: Bleed continues the page edge

checks.name: Bleed approximates the artwork at the cut
checks.detail: 261 of 6156 points differ by more than 30 units where both sides are coloured detail: the flat smear's limit on artwork that runs along the cut, entirely inside the 3 mm that is trimmed away
